title: Breast Lift After Weight Loss or Ozempic: When to Have It
meta_description: When to have a breast lift after weight loss or Ozempic: how long to keep your weight stable, why more skin changes the plan, and when implants come up.
excerpt: A breast lift after weight loss is easiest to plan around a weight you can keep. How long sources say to wait, what the evidence shows after Ozempic and other GLP-1 medications, when implants come up, and how loose skin changes the surgery.
quick_answer:
When should you have a breast lift after weight loss?

Once your weight has stopped changing, however you lost it. ASPS lists a stable weight as part of candidacy. Matthew Kilgo, MD, FACS, quoted on the ASPS website, typically recommends at least 3 to 6 months of documented stability, and The Aesthetic Society says at least 6 months after dramatic weight loss.
